summary_en: 550,000 shares (7.21% of ex-treasury S/O), ¥1,105.5M limit. ToSTNeT-3 execution at ¥2,010 closing price on 2026-08-13 08:45 JST. Results to be disclosed same day.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of treasury shares and purchase of treasury shares via off-auction trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 12 August 2026, Unirita Inc. (TSE Standard: 3800) resolved by board resolution to acquire treasury shares via a single ToSTNeT-3 block transaction. The board authorized acquisition of up to 550,000 shares (7.21% of the 7,631,748 shares outstanding excluding treasury) for a maximum outlay of ¥1,105.5 million. Execution occurred on 13 August 2026 at 08:45 JST at the closing price of ¥2,010 per share. Results are to be disclosed immediately following settlement. The company stated the acquisition aims to enhance shareholder value and capital efficiency while enabling flexible capital allocation in response to changing business conditions. As of 4 August 2026, the company held 368,252 treasury shares.
